_meta.description: FEAT-024 (ADR-0025): the 4 seeded Peripheral Blood Smear morphology analytes (RBC morphology: Anisocytosis, Poikilocytosis, Polychromasia; Platelet Estimate). This file proves the seed and the live analyte catalog agree on display name and dataType ('ordinal') -- it does NOT prove the LOINC codes or grading vocabulary are clinically authoritative. Design-partner sign-off is a separate, open item, same status as chemistry-ranges-criticals.json's own.
